<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="E5y9fJIYlh0W8aviVTqP"> <mxGraphModel dx="1554" dy="851" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
!theme plain
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

actor \"Customer / Agent\" as Users

package \"Client Layer\" {
 component \"React.js Frontend\n(Dashboards & Forms)\" as Frontend
}

package \"Application Server (FastAPI)\" {
 component \"Core API Gateway\" as Backend
 component \"SLA & Routing Engine\" as SLA
}

package \"In-House AI Pipeline\" {
 component \"SLM Inference Endpoint\n(Classification & Drafting)\" as Inference
 component \"LoRA Retraining Loop\" as Retrain
}

database \"PostgreSQL DB\n(Tickets, Audit, Feedback)\" as DB

Users --> Frontend : Interact
Frontend <--> Backend : REST / WebSockets
Backend --> SLA : Monitor Deadlines
Backend <--> DB : Read / Write
Backend --> Inference : Request AI Predictions
Inference --> Backend : Return JSON Results
DB ..> Retrain : Feed Agent Corrections
Retrain ..> Inference : Update Model Weights
@enduml",
 "config": null
